about_the_game:
In a turn-based strategy game, you'll navigate a world constantly invaded by the Demon King. Through your wisdom, overcome various challenges to become a legendary guild.

Dynamic Invasions, A World in Constant Flux!

The Demon King's monster overlords relentlessly invade towns, transforming once-prosperous lands into sinister monster lairs! Every journey will be filled with the unknown and challenging quests.

Assemble Your Brave Squad, Embark on an Epic Journey!

Lead your exclusive team of heroes, delve deep into monster-infested territories, banish the fiends, and uphold peace and order in the world!

Strategic Planning, Forge Your Exclusive Business Empire!

In a world fraught with peril, develop your town, construct unique commercial buildings, outshine competitors in fierce business rivalry, and accumulate vast wealth and prestige for your guild!

Tactical Turns, Challenge Unpredictable Monster Overlords!

Each monster overlord possesses unique characteristics! Employ your wisdom and strategy to outwit formidable foes and claim your rightful glory!

Contend for the Title of "Legendary Guild," Achieve Everlasting Fame!

In a world besieged by the Demon King, your brave squad is not just a gathering place for heroes, but a beacon of hope! Through your efforts, gain worldwide acclaim, become a revered Legendary Guild, and let your story resonate through the ages!
detailed_description:
About this Trial Version

This demo version includes the following content:

😈 Change: A world constantly invaded by the Demon King

⚔️ Adventure: Experience a brave hero squad

🏘️ Building: Construct various commercial buildings in towns with unique characteristics

👹 Combat: Monster bosses with diverse traits await your challenge

🏆 Competition: Compete with AI to see who becomes the "Legendary Guild"

The full version will offer:

🗺️ More diverse map options

🛡️ More hero squads

✨ A professional system for free combination of gameplay

💎 Rich treasure system

🏡 Various distinctive buildings in villages: shops, alchemy, adventure guilds, crystals, black market, etc.

🤝 Support for multiplayer, remote play
